name: MKP Mobility Limited
about: MKP Mobility Limited distributes and exports automobile spare parts and lubricants in India and internationally. It distributes industrial products, mechanical and electronic components, auto care products, tyres, batteries, and refurbished parts. The company was formerly known as Chitradurga Spintex Limited and changed its name to MKP Mobility Limited in December 2022. MKP Mobility Limited was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Pune, India.
